mapper.insert: INSERT INTO db_connection ( conn_key, display_name, jdbc_url, username, password_enc, driver_class, default_schema, pool_size, conn_timeout_ms, max_rows, query_timeout_s, enabled, created_by, created_at, updated_by, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{connKey}, #{displayName}, #{jdbcUrl}, #{username}, #{passwordEnc}, #{driverClass}, CAST(#{defaultSchema,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS VARCHAR), #{poolSize}, #{connTimeoutMs}, #{maxRows}, #{queryTimeoutS}, #{enabled}, #{createdBy}, now(), #{updatedBy}, now() )
mapper.update: UPDATE db_connection SET display_name = #{displayName}, jdbc_url = #{jdbcUrl}, username = #{username}, password_enc = #{passwordEnc}, driver_class = #{driverClass}, default_schema = #{defaultSchema}, pool_size = #{poolSize}, conn_timeout_ms = #{connTimeoutMs}, max_rows = #{maxRows}, query_timeout_s = #{queryTimeoutS}, enabled = #{enabled}, updated_by = #{updatedBy}, updated_at = now() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM db_connection ORDER BY id
SELECT * FROM db_connection WHERE enabled = 1 ORDER BY id
